items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 8:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the two Nesirot (sawings)? There are two Nesirot: the first is from the aspect of the chest and below of ZA, when she has no building of her own at all, and she is discerned as clinging to his body, in the secret of “and her back is within”, as is known. Then, by the slumber, which is the ascent of MAN to Aba and Ima, she attains Mochin of AB, which lower the lower Hey from her eyes and raise her AHP, and the lower thirds of every Sefira of her ten Sefirot are completed, by which she is sawn off from ZA, and she is built as the aspect of a complete Partzuf from the aspect of the vessels. As is known. However, in this state she is not fit for coupling with ZA in the manner of male and female, because her MAN is the aspect of male MAN, like the MAN of ZA, for her MAN too is the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, and therefore she can receive Mochin from the Mazal, as above in Answer 7. And therefore, in order that she be fit for coupling with ZA, she needs a second Nesira, namely to saw her off from the aspect of the back of ZA and bring her to the aspect of the face. As the Rav said on page 876, item 95: that after she was diminished to the point of the face, he sawed her off from his back and raised her up above, opposite his face. See there. By this second Nesira she is corrected in her own true measure, namely the aspect of actual Malchut, and she then receives actual Mochin of the Nukva, namely from the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of ZA. And then she is discerned as a Nukva fit for coupling with ZA, for now she has Mochin of the Nukva. Not so earlier, at the time she was in the back with a stature equal to his, for then she had male Mochin, like ZA himself, namely the Mochin of the Mazalot that come out upon male MAN, and she was not fit to couple with him. As explained. And see above, Answer 7, at its end. (Item 95 and Item 119).
